7_matched_path_real.interpretation: 200 U/MFE/MAE-matched pairs; giveback discriminates in 120 pairs; chop discriminates in 123 pairs; recovery discriminates in 195 pairs

Q1_U_only_sufficient_for_Expected_Return.evidence: ABC: U z ranks B>A (grind > spike utility); U encodes sustained favorable occupancy not max opportunity tier

Q2_MFE_adds_non_redundant_info.evidence: MFE_residual exists (R2(U->MFE)=0.83 on BTC); links to future_opportunity (max excursion beyond U); archetype A>B on MFE facet

Q3_U_MFE_scalar_appropriate.evidence: z(U)+z(MFE) keeps B first on ABC; semantic loss vs separate heads

Q4_MAE_only_Acceptable_Risk.evidence: MAE separates A vs C but not A vs B giveback erosion or B vs G chop whip

Q5_giveback_essential.evidence: B<A giveback on ABC; matched-path giveback discrimination on real+synthetic

Q6_chop_independent_of_giveback.evidence: Independent on B vs G (similar giveback, chop differs); eval corr low

Q7_risk_scalar_sum_ok.evidence: R3 sum hides chop driver on G; separate heads required

Q8_recovery_needed_in_P1_Risk.evidence: Raw recovery discriminates same-MAE REC pair; z-score weakens separation — P1 diagnostic yes, canonical Risk facet not yet justified

Q9_zscore_damages_semantics.evidence: Preserves ABC ordering on eval; converts absolute risk to prefix rarity; archetype tail |z|>>4; recovery variance collapse

Q10_direction_EV_over_categorical.evidence: Action EV preserves Return/Risk head separation; categorical loses magnitude; P vs Return disagreement 16.7%

maintain: U-only insufficient for Expected Return tier semantics

Return must be separate heads — not z(U)+z(MFE) scalar
giveback essential for B<A risk on spike-giveback paths
Risk separate heads — not naive scalar sum
Direction via action EV preferred over categorical-only
modify: Recovery: Round 1 'optional 4th facet' -> Round 2 'P1 diagnostic only until z/refit fixes separation'
MFE independence: 'yes' -> PARTIAL (high R2(U->MFE) on eval; residual links path quality)
Z-score: 'acceptable' -> PARTIAL (prefix rarity semantics must be documented; recovery weak)
discard: Adopting z(U)+z(MFE) as single Expected Return scalar
Treating recovery z separation as sufficient for canonical Risk head adoption
